# FemiCore

> FemiCore is a Women's urinary tract & bladder health supplement. FemiCore is a daily dietary supplement formulated to support women's urinary tract health, bladder control, and urinary microbiome balance. It is designed to be taken once a day as part of a regular wellness routine, using a blend of ingredients that target the urinary system and the microbial environment of the bladder and urinary tract. Unlike general-purpose women's multivitamins, FemiCore focuses specifically on the lower urinary tract, helping maintain a healthy balance of flora while supporting normal bladder function and control. The formula is intended for adult women seeking proactive, ongoing support for urinary comfort and confidence.
